name: ecirace-go-frontend-tests
description: Pruebas del frontend de ECIRace GO (jsdom + Vitest) con cobertura Istanbul para SonarCloud

scripts.coverage: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.nyc_output',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vitest run && nyc report --temp-dir .nyc_output --report-dir coverage/frontend --reporter=lcov --reporter=text-summary
